content: BUD-17 PR 106 defines 2 MiB chunked file manifests, max 174 links per node, recursive traversal, and structural directory fanout nodes t=3 with child metadata count/first/last; older draft t=2 _chunk fanout may be read for compatibility but new writers should emit t=3. Pitfalls include wrong chunk key derivation, out-of-order chunks, recursive explosion, and fanout ambiguity.
